title: Adjectives (All Cases)
intro: You've now learned adjective endings for all six cases! This lesson brings them together. The key patterns: Nominative has unique endings (-ый/-ая/-ое/-ые). Accusative depends on animacy (animate masc = genitive). Genitive, dative, instrumental, and prepositional each have their patterns. Feminine is easiest - genitive/dative/instrumental/prepositional all use -ой/-ей! Master these patterns and you can describe anything in Russian.
rules: Feminine oblique cases (gen/dat/inst/prep) all use the same ending -ой/-ей — this is the easiest pattern to remember.
Accusative is the trickiest case: inanimate masculine looks like nominative, but animate masculine looks like genitive.
Dative (-ому) vs prepositional (-ом): the extra -у in dative is the key distinguishing feature for masculine/neuter.
When unsure of the case, identify the verb or preposition first — they determine which case the adjective must take.
examples: Новый студент читает. (The new student is reading.), nom
Я вижу нового студента. (I see the new student.), acc (animate)
Книга нового студента. (The new student's book.), gen
Я помогаю новому студенту. (I help the new student.), dat

items.prompt: _____ студент пришёл. (The new student arrived.) - nominative
Я вижу _____ студента. (I see the new student.) - accusative
Это книга _____ студента. (This is the new student's book.) - genitive
items.promptEnglish: This is the new student's book.

items.prompt: Я помогаю _____ студенту. (I help the new student.) - dative
Я говорю с _____ студентом. (I'm talking with the new student.) - instrumental
items.promptEnglish: I'm talking with the new student.

items.prompt: Я думаю о _____ студенте. (I'm thinking about the new student.) - prepositional
items.promptEnglish: I'm thinking about the new student.

items.prompt: Я читаю _____ книгу. (I'm reading an interesting book.) - accusative
Нет _____ книги. (There is no interesting book.) - genitive
Я рад _____ новостям. (I'm glad for the good news.) - dative
items.promptEnglish: I'm glad for the good news.

Это книга _____ подруги. (This is my good friend's book.)

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Adjective endings across all six cases
hints: С (with) requires instrumental case. Людьми is plural. What is the plural instrumental adjective ending?
Вижу (I see) takes accusative. Студент is animate masculine. Animate masculine accusative = which other case?
Possession (чья книга?) uses genitive. Подруга is feminine. Feminine genitive ending: -ой or -ую?
Помогаю (I help) takes dative. Студент is masculine. Masculine dative ending: -ому or -ом?
О (about) requires prepositional. Фильм is masculine. Masculine prepositional ending: -ом or -ому?
explanations: С requires instrumental. Plural: хорошие → хорошими (ending -ими).
Animate masculine accusative = genitive: новый → нового.
Possession uses genitive. Feminine: хорошая → хорошей (ending -ей).
Помогать takes dative. Masculine: новый → новому (ending -ому).
О requires prepositional. Masculine: интересный → интересном (ending -ом).
